Multi-Unit District) to RT-4 (Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District) to
allow construction of one (1) new three-story building with six (6) dwelling units in place of the
previously approved two (2) buildings with three (3) units each. This application is submitted as
a Type | Zoning Map Amendment pursuant to §1 7-13-0300 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.
